description: Continue with ChatGPT: start ChatGPT sign-in so that OpenAI models asked through ask_model use your ChatGPT plan. Returns the sign-in link right away (it also tries to open the browser); call chatgpt_plan_status afterwards for the result. The sign-in and its tokens stay on this machine.
